production: CPU execution unchanged from baseline; stable Rust, one interpreter; experiments archived
scope: All recorded timings retained. Preliminary screens have one or two samples; formal full-workload comparisons have three. No timing gate. Samples retain output/checksum and runtime counters; repetitive per-native-function profiling is not duplicated here. Host is shared x86_64; QEMU ARM64 results are emulated-host observations, not iPad measurements. No compilation or other tests by this task overlapped measurement. Each cohort names and fingerprints both runners; ratios cannot be compounded across cohorts.

array-arm.scope: Alternating baseline/candidate, identical guest programs and fresh cloned app stores; warm caches on a shared host; affinity recorded, frequency not controlled. CoreMark default single-thread -O2. Apps use the same complete hybrid musl, pure routing, allocator routing off. CoreMark and static CPU/SMP fixtures use their original libc. QEMU host timings, when selected, test ARM64 code generation, not device speed.
